title: Sri Lanka Retreat: Kandy and Bentota in Five Days
alt: Palm trees leaning over the sand at Bentota beach
transport: Private air conditioned car with an English speaking chauffeur guide throughout

stops.name: Kandy
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast and dinner · Deluxe room · 3★ · Deluxe class hotel in the hills above Kandy town

activities.name: Private visit to Pinnawala
activities.description: A stop on the way up from the airport to watch the resident herd bathe in the Maha Oya river and feed at the sanctuary.

activities.name: Private lake drive and Kandyan dance show
activities.description: An evening circuit of the lake followed by a traditional performance of drummers, masked dancers and the closing fire walk.

program.name: Kandy
program.description: One night in the hill capital with a private elephant sanctuary visit on the way and a private lake drive and dance show.

stops.name: Bentota
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast and dinner · Deluxe room · 3★ · Deluxe class beach hotel with a pool facing the sea

activities.name: Peradeniya gardens and Kadugannawa tea factory
activities.description: The royal botanical gardens at Peradeniya and a working tea factory at Kadugannawa on the way to the coast.

activities.name: Madu Ganga boat safari and Kosgoda turtle hatchery
activities.description: A boat through the mangrove islands of the Madu Ganga, then the turtle hatchery at Kosgoda.

program.name: Bentota
program.description: Two nights on the beach with Peradeniya gardens, a tea factory, the Madu Ganga boat and the turtle hatchery on the way down, then a free day.

stops.name: Colombo
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast and dinner · Deluxe room · 3★ · Historic harbourside hotel in the Colombo Fort district

activities.name: Private full day Colombo sightseeing
activities.description: Galle Face Green, the Gangaramaya temple, the colonial Fort district, the Lotus Tower and the floating market at Pettah.

program.name: Colombo
program.description: A last night in the Fort district with a private full day of the capital.

day_titles.1: Arrival in Colombo and on to Kandy
day_titles.2: Gardens, tea and the Madu Ganga

1: Arrival at Bandaranaike International and private transfer inland
A private stop at the Pinnawala elephant sanctuary
Check in at your Kandy hotel
A private lake drive and the Kandyan dance performance
2: Breakfast, then the Peradeniya Royal Botanical Gardens
A tea factory tour and tasting at Kadugannawa
A boat safari on the Madu Ganga and the Kosgoda turtle hatchery
Check in at Bentota for sunset
3: Breakfast and the whole day on the beach
Optional: jet ski, banana boat or a glass bottom boat at the river mouth
Optional: an ayurvedic massage at the resort
4: Breakfast and a transfer down the coast to Colombo
Galle Face Green and the Gangaramaya temple complex
The Fort district, the Lotus Tower and Pettah market
Dinner and your last night at the hotel
5: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Private transfer to Bandaranaike International for your flight home

expert.name: Aditya
expert.role: Sri Lanka expert at Hi Tours
expert.quote: Bentota is where the trip exhales. After the temples and tea estates, three nights by the water is exactly the right medicine.
expert.tip: Ask for an early start on the Galle day. The fort ramparts are empty before ten and the light on the lighthouse is at its best.

summary: Five compact days: a night in Kandy with the elephants and the dance show, two nights at Bentota with Peradeniya, a tea factory, the Madu Ganga boat and the turtles on the way, and a last night in Colombo.
included: Included: 4 nights in deluxe class hotels with breakfast and lunch or dinner daily; private airport transfers and all road travel in an air conditioned car with chauffeur guide; a private Pinnawala elephant sanctuary visit; private Kandy lake drive and dance show; Peradeniya botanical gardens and the Kadugannawa tea factory; the Madu Ganga boat safari and Kosgoda turtle hatchery; a private full day Colombo sightseeing tour.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Sri Lanka ETA visa fees; lunches unless stated; entrance tickets where marked as payable locally; travel insurance; optional excursions; tips and personal expenses.
